title: How would you estimate the yearly revenue of one busy London coffee shop?
description: A step-by-step estimate for "What is the yearly revenue of one busy London coffee shop?" with the approach, the maths and a sanity check.
hook: Sizing a single business, rather than a whole market, is common in cases. The key is a believable number of customers per day. Have a go at your own estimate before reading on.
body:
The question

What is the yearly revenue of one busy London coffee shop?

The approach

Cups per day × average spend per cup × days open.

Tip: Keep your page tidy: one line per step, the running total circled at the end.

Step by step

  1. Cups sold per day: 500
  2. × £3.5 average spend per cup, including food add-ons
  3. × 360 days open per year

That gives about £630k a year.

Does it make sense?

About £1,750 a day: one person at the till serving one customer every minute or so for eight hours.
